title: Choose comment targets
responsibility: Resolve design options and image targets and build comment anchors for the viewed revision.

inputs.name: imageTarget.version
inputs.description: Design version containing the selected image.

inputs.name: imageTarget.image
inputs.description: Selected image metadata.

inputs.name: imageTarget.region
inputs.description: Selected image rectangle, or null.

inputs.name: optionImages.design
inputs.description: Design version to inspect, or undefined.

inputs.name: optionImages.option
inputs.description: Option ID whose images are requested.

inputs.name: designOption.design
inputs.description: Design version whose option is selected.

inputs.name: designOption.wanted
inputs.description: Preferred option ID; defaults to empty.

inputs.name: shownApproval.design
inputs.description: Design and approval to inspect.

inputs.name: shownApproval.latest
inputs.description: Latest version ID against which approval is checked.

inputs.name: shownApproval.option
inputs.description: Displayed option ID; defaults to empty.

inputs.name: versionOption.versions
inputs.description: Available design versions.

inputs.name: versionOption.version
inputs.description: Version ID to find.

inputs.name: versionOption.wanted
inputs.description: Preferred option ID for that version.

inputs.name: otherOption.item
inputs.description: Optional target with version and option.

inputs.name: otherOption.version
inputs.description: Version currently shown.

inputs.name: otherOption.option
inputs.description: Option currently shown.

inputs.name: designTarget.design
inputs.description: Design version from which to select a target.

inputs.name: designTarget.option
inputs.description: Option whose first image should be selected.

inputs.name: threadAnchor.revision
inputs.description: Viewed branch and commit.

inputs.name: threadAnchor.entityId
inputs.description: Entity receiving the comment.

inputs.name: threadAnchor.target
inputs.description: Selected version, image hash, state, viewport and region.

inputs.name: sameImage.left
inputs.description: First target to compare.

inputs.name: sameImage.right
inputs.description: Second target to compare.

outputs.name: entityTarget
outputs.description: Entity-wide target with null version, image, state, viewport and region.

outputs.name: imageTarget
outputs.description: Image target with version, hash, state, viewport, region and option when present.

outputs.name: optionImages
outputs.description: All images for a single design, matching option images for an optioned design, or an empty list without a design.

outputs.name: designOption
outputs.description: Valid preferred option, otherwise the current approved option when valid, otherwise the first option; empty for a single design.

outputs.name: shownApproval
outputs.description: Whether the current approval names the latest version and, for options, matches the shown option and image hashes.

outputs.name: versionOption
outputs.description: Resolved option for the requested version.

outputs.name: otherOption
outputs.description: Whether the item belongs to the same version but a different nonempty option.

outputs.name: designTarget
outputs.description: First image target of the selected option, or an entity-wide target when there is no image.

outputs.name: threadAnchor
outputs.description: Comment anchor combining revision, entity and target fields.

outputs.name: sameImage
outputs.description: True when both targets share a nonempty image hash and version.
